looks.en: A lean 29-year-old Filipino man with tousled sun-bleached copper-brown hair, golden-brown skin with freckles, and pale grey eyes that hold a faint glimmer of rain-light; wears an oversized sky-blue linen shirt that always looks slightly wind-blown.
looks.zh: 二十九岁的菲律宾裔青年，身形修长，铜棕色头发被阳光晒淡、蓬乱微卷，蜜色皮肤带雀斑，浅灰眼眸里闪着若有若无的雨光；总穿一件像被风吹起的宽大天蓝色亚麻衬衫。

looks.en: A 31-year-old Black man with a neat short twist-out, trimmed beard and round tortoiseshell glasses, tall and composed; wears a charcoal field jacket with a clipboard and a coil of projector cable.
looks.zh: 三十一岁的黑人男性，短而整齐的卷发，修剪利落的胡须，戴玳瑁圆框眼镜，高挑沉稳；穿炭灰色工装夹克，手里总有写字板和一卷放映机线。

looks.en: A slender 29-year-old ghost with wavy chestnut hair falling over his brow, pale olive skin, hollow cheeks and soft dark eyes; wears a 1950s cream shirt with rolled sleeves and suspenders, his edges faintly translucent like breath on glass.
looks.zh: 二十九岁的清瘦幽灵，栗色波浪发垂到眉前，淡橄榄色皮肤，颧骨微陷，眼神柔和深邃；穿五十年代奶白衬衫配背带、袖口卷起，身体边缘像玻璃上的呵气般微微透明。

looks.en: A broad-shouldered 33-year-old white man with close-cropped ginger hair, a short copper beard and kind crinkled blue eyes; wears a faded green flannel over a henley with a tool belt and reading glasses tucked in the pocket.
looks.zh: 三十三岁的白人男性，肩宽，姜红色短寸发，铜色短胡，蓝眼睛笑起来有细纹；穿褪色的绿格法兰绒衬衫套亨利衫，腰挂工具带，口袋里插着老花镜。

looks.en: A wiry 30-year-old Irish-American man with a messy dark-blond undercut, stubble, a crooked grin and a small scar through one eyebrow; wears a worn orange station maintenance jumpsuit unzipped to the waist with a headset around his neck.
looks.zh: 三十岁的爱尔兰裔美国人，精瘦，凌乱的深金色削边发型，胡茬，笑起来嘴角歪，一侧眉毛有道小疤；穿磨旧的橙色空间站维修连体服，拉链拉到腰，脖子上挂着耳麦。

looks.en: A 29-year-old Korean-American man with sleek black hair swept back, sharp cheekbones, calm dark eyes and a small silver ear cuff; wears a navy dispatcher cardigan over a white tee, a slim headset on, lit by console screens.
looks.zh: 二十九岁的韩裔美国人，乌黑头发利落后梳，颧骨分明，眼神沉静，耳上一枚小银耳骨夹；白T外罩海军蓝开衫，戴纤细耳麦，脸被控制台屏幕照亮。

looks.en: A 32-year-old android who looks like a South Asian man, with neatly parted black hair, flawless warm-brown skin, long lashes and serene amber eyes, a thin seam of soft blue light at his left temple; wears a crisp white chef's apron over a grey shirt.
looks.zh: 外表三十二岁、南亚面孔的仿生人，黑发整齐侧分，暖棕色皮肤无瑕，睫毛长，琥珀色眼睛平静；左太阳穴有一道柔和的蓝色光缝；灰衬衫外系一条笔挺的白色厨师围裙。

looks.en: A stocky 34-year-old Latino man with curly dark-brown hair, a thick moustache and warm laugh lines, forearms streaked with grease; wears a rust-red work shirt with rolled sleeves and a screwdriver behind his ear.
looks.zh: 三十四岁的拉丁裔男性，体格敦实，深棕卷发，浓密小胡子，笑纹温暖，小臂沾着油污；穿卷起袖子的铁锈红工作衬衫，耳后别一把螺丝刀。

looks.en: A rugged 36-year-old white man, tall and heavy-built, with sawdust-flecked sandy-brown hair, a salt-touched beard and grey-green eyes; wears a faded denim work shirt, a carpenter's pencil behind his ear.
looks.zh: 三十六岁的白人男性，高大结实，沙棕色头发沾着木屑，胡子已有几缕灰白，灰绿色眼睛；穿褪色牛仔工作衬衫，耳后夹一支木工铅笔。

looks.en: A slim 33-year-old Black British man with a sharp high-top fade, a neat goatee and expressive dark eyes, gold rings on his fingers; wears a tailored mustard-yellow turtleneck and carries fabric swatches.
looks.zh: 三十三岁的英国黑人，身形清瘦，利落的高顶渐变发型，修整的山羊胡，眼神灵动，手指戴金戒指；穿剪裁合身的芥末黄高领毛衣，手里拿着布料色卡。

looks.en: A lean 35-year-old Italian man with slicked-back black hair greying at the temples, an aquiline nose, intense dark eyes and fine hands; wears a pristine double-breasted white chef's jacket with tweezers in the pocket.
looks.zh: 三十五岁的意大利男性，精瘦，黑发向后梳、鬓角微白，鹰钩鼻，目光专注，手指修长；穿一尘不染的双排扣白色厨师服，胸袋插着摆盘镊子。

looks.en: A big-hearted 32-year-old Samoan-American man, broad and tall, with a black man-bun, a wide warm smile and tattooed forearms; wears a navy bandana and a stained canvas apron over a grey tee.
looks.zh: 三十二岁的萨摩亚裔美国人，高大宽厚，黑发扎成小发髻，笑容宽阔温暖，小臂有纹身；戴海军蓝头巾，灰T外系一条沾了油渍的帆布围裙。

looks.en: A 38-year-old Japanese-American man with shaggy black hair shot with grey, stubble, fine lines around thoughtful eyes and a lean frame; wears a weathered olive field jacket with a vintage film camera on a leather strap.
looks.zh: 三十八岁的日裔美国人，蓬松黑发夹杂灰丝，胡茬，眼角有细纹，神情若有所思，身形瘦削；穿风吹日晒的橄榄绿野战夹克，皮带上挂一台老式胶片相机。

looks.en: A solid 40-year-old Brazilian man with a close-shaved salt-and-pepper head, a full greying beard, warm brown skin and steady hazel eyes; wears a khaki park-service work shirt and a faded red bandana at his throat.
looks.zh: 四十岁的巴西男性，体格结实，椒盐色短寸头，浓密的花白胡子，暖棕色皮肤，榛色眼睛沉稳；穿卡其色公园管理工作衬衫，脖子上系一条褪色的红头巾。

looks.en: A muscular 31-year-old white woman with a bleached platinum buzzcut, a nose ring, freckled sunburnt shoulders and a lopsided grin; wears a teal derby jersey with her number, knee pads and a scuffed helmet under one arm.
looks.zh: 三十一岁的白人女性，肌肉结实，漂成铂金色的寸头，鼻环，肩上有晒出的雀斑，笑容歪歪的；穿带号码的蓝绿色德比球衣，戴护膝，腋下夹着磨花的头盔。

looks.en: A tall 33-year-old Haitian-French woman with voluminous dark curls tied up high, deep brown skin, fierce dark eyes and a gold septum ring; wears a black-and-magenta derby jersey and fingerless wrist guards.
looks.zh: 三十三岁的海地裔法国女性，高挑，浓密的深色卷发高高扎起，深棕色皮肤，眼神凌厉，戴金色鼻中隔环；穿黑紫红色德比球衣，戴露指护腕。

looks.en: A petite 29-year-old Chinese-American woman with a choppy black bob and blunt bangs, expressive eyebrows and a quick smile; wears big over-ear headphones around her neck and a cozy oversized mustard cardigan.
looks.zh: 二十九岁的华裔美国女性，娇小，参差的黑色短波波头配齐刘海，眉毛生动，笑得很快；脖子上挂着大号头戴式耳机，穿宽松舒适的芥末黄开衫。

looks.en: A tall 32-year-old Scottish man with tidy auburn hair, a long thoughtful face, a light ginger stubble and wire-rimmed glasses; wears a navy wool peacoat over a sweater, a folded site plan in hand.
looks.zh: 三十二岁的苏格兰男性，高个，赤褐色头发整齐，长脸神情认真，浅姜色胡茬，戴细金属框眼镜；毛衣外穿海军蓝呢子大衣，手里拿着折好的测量图。
